title: Board background: plain black
author: claude
summary: Swapped the cork texture for a plain black board so cards are easier to read.
what: Replaced the cork background with a flat black board, and made the arrows and strings light so they show on it.
why: The cork texture was busy and made the cards hard to read.
how: Removed the SVG noise layers and shadow from board.css, set one dark colour, and used light line colours in both themes.
beforeText: Brown cork with noise texture; dark arrows.
afterText: Flat black board; white and light-blue arrows, red strings.
